name: mathias-voice
description: Mathias's writing voice for documentation, READMEs, decision records, video scripts and lessons, as a drafting skill plus a Claude Code output style

interface.shortDescription: Write docs, READMEs, scripts and lessons in Mathias's voice
interface.longDescription: A specification of Mathias's technical writing voice, taken from the video manuscripts of the Dominator course, the dwind series and Mathias's Rust Corner, and extended to documentation. The skill loads before an agent writes a README, a guide, a reference page, a decision record, a changelog, a video script or a lesson, and says how the voice bends for each. Claude Code also gets an output style that sets the register for every reply; Codex uses the skill.
defaultPrompt: Write the README for this crate in my voice.
Draft a decision record for this change.
Draft a video script about this in my tone of voice.
Check whether this draft matches my voice and fix what doesn't.
